title: 第21章 千代vs威廉第22章 直面死亡
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
威廉的目光如利剑般锐利，直指千代。
他的声音在训练场上回荡，带着贵族骑士特有的傲慢和自信。
“那边的东流岛人，"
威廉冷笑着说，"
敢上来一战吗？"
千代扎起的黑发在微风中轻轻飘动，她的眼神冷漠如冰，对威廉的挑衅不为所动。
站在一旁的法伦低声问：“能赢吗？”
“会赢的！”
伊莎贝拉老师眉头微蹙，她注意到了威廉言辞中的不妥，但很快又舒展开来，这样才有意思不是吗？毕竟这在她的印象中还是第一次，贵族与平民的矛盾在预科班就爆发了。
千代的声音平静而直接，"
我并不在意你的挑衅，也无需证明什么。
但既然你如此渴望展示你的无能，我便满足你的愿望。
威廉并没有被千代的反击所激怒，冷笑一声：“看来你们这些平民都只有嘴皮子厉害吧？”
千代步履轻盈地走向训练场中央，面对着威廉。
伊莎贝拉带着看热闹不嫌事大的眼神看着眼前的两位学生，同样她知道这样的较量对于他们的成长至关重要，但同时也需要给他们敲响警钟。
“召唤术的较量应当以技艺和尊重为基础。”
伊莎贝拉看向威廉，“记住，这是一场技艺的交流，不是仇恨的滋生地。
看来伊莎贝拉老师并没有阻止二人战斗的意思，其余的同学都退到了召唤决斗场外面，把场地留给了两人。
“你们两人都是有力的种子选手候补，谁受伤了都是导师们不愿意看到的。”
伊莎贝拉老师继续说，“这样子吧，你们决斗的规则就改为武器触及到身体便被判负如何？”

“被刀枪什么的碰一下就不算受伤了吗？”
法伦在一旁暗自嘀咕。
伊莎贝拉老师的手指在半空中画出一个法阵，一面古老的镜子从法阵中浮现出来，这面镜子的边框上刻满了复杂的符文，镜面闪烁着淡淡的光芒，仿佛蕴含着某种神秘的力量。
这面镜子是我的召唤兽，"
伊莎贝拉老师解释道，"
它能够创造出一个一次性的保护结界，确保你们的决斗不会对对方造成伤害。
随着伊莎贝拉老师的咒语，镜子中的光华流转，逐渐在威廉和千代周围形成了一个半透明的光罩。
这个光罩闪烁着温和的光芒，给人一种安心的感觉。
“暗自庆幸吧！
老师为了不让你丢大脸，居然还用上了防护性魔法。”
威廉嘴上继续挑衅道。
content_en:
William's gaze was as sharp as a sword, pointing directly at Chiyo.
His voice echoed across the training ground, carrying the arrogance and confidence unique to a noble knight.
"The people from Dongliu Island over there,"
William sneered and said, "
Do you dare to come up and fight? "
Chiyo's tied black hair was fluttering gently in the breeze, her eyes were as cold as ice, and she was unmoved by William's provocation.
Fallon, standing aside, asked in a low voice: "Can you win?"
"Will win!"
Teacher Isabella frowned slightly. She noticed the inappropriateness in William's words, but she quickly relaxed. This is interesting, isn't it? After all, this was the first time in her memory that the conflict between nobles and commoners broke out in the preparatory class.
Chiyo's voice was calm and direct, "
I don't care about your provocation, and I don't need to prove anything.
But since you are so eager to demonstrate your incompetence, I will grant your wish.
William was not angered by Chiyo's counterattack and sneered: "It seems that you commoners are only good at talking, right? "
Chiyo walked lightly to the center of the training ground and faced William.
Isabella looked at the two students in front of her with a look that was not too serious about the excitement. She also knew that this kind of competition was crucial to their growth, but at the same time, it also needed to sound a warning to them.
“Contests in summoning should be based on skill and respect. "
Isabella looked at William, “Remember, this is an exchange of skills, not a breeding ground for hatred.
It seemed that Teacher Isabella had no intention of stopping the two from fighting. The rest of the students retreated outside the summoning duel field, leaving the place to the two of them.
"Both of you are strong candidates for seeding. The mentors don't want to see anyone get injured."
Teacher Isabella continued, "How about this, the rules of your duel are changed to be punished if the weapon touches the body?"
"Doesn't it count as an injury if you are touched by a knife or a gun?"
Fallon muttered to himself.
Teacher Isabella's fingers drew a magic circle in mid-air, and an ancient mirror emerged from the magic circle. The frame of this mirror was engraved with complex runes, and the mirror surface shone with a faint light, as if it contained some mysterious power.
This mirror is my summoned beast,"
Teacher Isabella explained, "
It can create a one-time protective barrier to ensure that your duel will not cause harm to the other party.
Following Teacher Isabella's spell, the light in the mirror flowed, gradually forming a translucent light mask around William and Chiyo.
This light mask shimmers with a gentle glow, giving it a reassuring feel.
"Rejoice secretly!
In order to prevent you from being embarrassed, the teacher even used protective magic. "
William continued to speak provocatively.
